content.value: The following consecutive readings were taken with a level and a 4-meter (20) leveling staff on a continuously sloping ground at common intervals of 50 m: 3.776 m (on A), 2.502 m, 2.323 m, 3.128 m, 3.813 m, 4.056 m, 4.367 m, 3.056 m, 3.434 m, 1.518 m, 0.587 m, 3.705 m, 4.507 m and 4.364 m (on B). The RL of A was 137.500 m. Make entries in a level book and apply the usual checks. The change points were taken at 150 m and 400 m in chainage.
